name: Tester
tagline: This internal tool is used as a desktop sandbox in our CI process to grab a screenshot of a hopefully functional endpoint
description: This internal tool is used as a desktop sandbox in our CI process to grab a screenshot of a hopefully functional endpoint

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/tester:version-66f677b0@sha256:976ed6115060a646cf9e427b003d048d1a5aecfa4ded89b9bb7a2d5a5db9e839
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      URL: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
